screen.lightspeed.startup_advice.title: Lightspeed Agent Configuration
screen.lightspeed.startup_advice.message: Lightspeed's early Bootstrap Agent (-javaagent) is not active yet. Clicking "Write Agent Arguments" adds the required JVM arguments to your launcher profile so early class-loading, module-graph, and scanner optimizations take effect on your next launch. You can also choose "Skip" to continue playing as-is.

Automatically supported launchers: PCL2, HMCL, Prism Launcher / MultiMC / PolyMC, Official Launcher, CurseForge App, ATLauncher.
For other launchers or custom launch scripts, open "Manual Guide" below.
Agent arguments have been written (%s). Restart the game to activate them; if your launcher caches instance settings (such as PCL2), reopen the launcher first.
Lightspeed could not detect or update your launcher profile automatically. The Bootstrap Agent JAR has been prepared locally—please follow the manual tutorial below.
Note: Current Java feature version is %s (< 21). Switching to Java 21 enables additional module-graph and runtime startup optimizations.
Lightspeed Agent is active. Your current Java version is below 21; consider using Java 21 for additional startup optimizations.
screen.lightspeed.startup_advice.tutoria: Manual Configuration Guide (For Other / Custom Launchers)

Step 1: Click "Copy JVM Arguments" below (keep existing -Xmx memory flags intact).
Step 2: Open your launcher's Instance/Profile Settings -> Java -> JVM Arguments, add a space after existing arguments, and paste.
Step 3: Save settings and restart the game.

Launcher JVM Argument Locations:
- PCL2: Version Settings -> Settings -> Advanced Launch Options -> JVM Arguments
- HMCL: Version Settings -> Specific Game Settings -> JVM Arguments
- Prism Launcher / MultiMC / PolyMC: Edit Instance -> Settings -> Java -> check "Java arguments"
- BakaXL: Version Settings -> Advanced Settings -> JVM Arguments
- CurseForge App: Settings / Profile -> Minecraft -> Additional Arguments
- ATLauncher: Edit Instance -> Settings -> Java/Minecraft Parameters
- Modrinth App: Instance Options -> Java -> Custom java arguments
- Official Launcher: Installations -> Edit -> More Options -> JVM Arguments
- Other Launchers / Scripts: Append the copied flags, or click "Open Agent Folder" to locate the JAR:
%s
screen.lightspeed.startup_advice.argumen: Agent arguments are unavailable outside a packaged Mod JAR. Standard loader optimizations remain active.
